svg.title: Migration portfolio decision gates
svg.desc: Four numbered gates in reading order: inventory business capabilities, owners and dependency evidence; choose a seven-R strategy for each workload and compare full twelve-month cost; schedule dependency groups within team capacity and the change window; then rehearse, reconcile and obtain business-owner acceptance. An unknown critical link at scheduling returns the plan to inventory and discovery. Every wave needs licensing, recovery, overlap, retained-copy and current-rate evidence. A green migration task status does not establish business acceptance.
svg.text: Four gates before naming a migration date
A green tool status does not prove the business can use the target.
Cost evidence: license + recovery + overlap + retained copies + current rates.
Business check: bookings, attachments and payment references still work.
